about: RFMiD 1.0 images excluded from 'deduplicated' evaluations: each shows the same eye as an image in an earlier official split (train for val; train or val for test), by a geometric match of the retina (>= 8 RANSAC inliers). Generated by `python -m eye_rag.dedup`; see docs/DATA.md, 'Duplicate audit'. The official split itself is unchanged.
rule: same eye if RANSAC inliers >= 8 (all 5118400 pairs checked)
